title: Small bar licence
summary: Find out about and apply for a small bar liquor licence in New South Wales.

internal_links.text: Apply for a small bar liquor licence
Check a small bar liquor licence

faqs.q: What is a small bar liquor licence?
faqs.a: A small bar liquor licence allows you to sell liquor in a small bar setting.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a small bar liquor licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a small bar liquor licence using the dedicated application page.

faqs.q: How can I check the status of a liquor licence?
faqs.a: You can check a liquor licence using the online checking tool.
